Quick alignment ask as we lock QBR content this week. Two related items I want us to finalize before the executive readout on Friday:

Thanks —

Subject: Leadership update: Product Ops ownership transition and Q2 priorities

Team,

Today we are making a small leadership adjustment meant to accelerate our reliability and platform work.

In brief: we are transitioning ownership for Platform Reliability and customer-facing SLAs to Product Ops. This change centralizes responsibility for incident response, runbooks, and long-lived performance investments so engineering and product teams can focus on feature velocity and model improvements.

What this means for customers and partners:
- No interruption to product roadmaps: customer-facing features proceed as planned.
- Improved incident responsiveness: targeted MTTR reduction within 60 days.
- Hiring and backfill updates will be shared in the next manager note.

If you have questions, reach out to your manager or directly to Laura and Vivek.

Thank you,
Jonas Weber
